::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
**Multi-agent systems** decompose a task across a network of specialized agents that communicate,
delegate, and check each other's work. Individual agents may use any backbone; the architectural
question is how they coordinate — message passing, shared memory, or hierarchical orchestration.
:::

**Depends on:** [Tool Use & Function Calling](02_tool_use.qmd)
